prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1420; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver side by a second vehicle while proceeding through on a green signal. Policyholder reports the other driver ran a red light. Police report requested from the responding agency. Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness following the impact and says she was transported to urgent care as a precaution.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. She is not represented by an attorney and says she has not yet spoken with anyone else about the claim. Explained the claims process, the statement request, and the medical documentation we will need. Claimant confirmed she has been seeing her primary care provider for ongoing neck strain symptoms and will forward records. Requested a recorded statement, which she agreed to schedule for later this week.

Entry 3: Recorded statement taken from claimant. Her account matches the policyholder's description of the signal phase. She reports neck strain with limited range of motion when turning her head to the left and intermittent headaches. She has been advised to keep all treatment appointments and to tell us about any new providers. Photographs of both vehicles' damage received from the insured and placed in the file. Independent appraisal assigned.

Entry 4: Police report received. It notes the other driver was cited for failing to obey a traffic control device. Other driver's carrier has been notified and has acknowledged the claim under their own file number. Liability appears clear on the available evidence. Medical records from urgent care received and reviewed; diagnosis is cervical strain with a recommended course of physical therapy. Claimant has been sent a letter explaining that she is free to seek legal advice at any time, as she is currently unrepresented.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant to check on treatment progress. She reports she has started physical therapy and that symptoms are slowly improving, though she still experiences some stiffness in the mornings. She has not requested a settlement figure at this time. Physical therapy progress notes requested with her authorization. Diary set for review in thirty days or sooner if records arrive earlier. File remains open pending medical updates and final appraisal.
